title: chore: defect hunt (11-03 #10): file 2-4 evidence-backed bug rows from the delivery-record tools and stores, the proposal and rail family, and the step-lifecycle tools' guards
description:
Filed by the governor at 20:15Z on 2026-11-03, the same lever as hunts #1-#9. Hunt #9 (task-66961b32) filed 4 rows between 19:41Z and 19:59Z, and the governor filed 1 follow-up (0adea941). One of them, 67709965, reached REVIEW within 15 minutes.

WHY. At filing time 7 coders are idle. PLANNING holds 4 rows (3 are being planned now), which covers only 4 of them. The only other WORKING rows are the serial CQ-M07 chain (n3 23c803d2, n 62ec51f1).

LANE. Search in this order of preference:
1. The delivery-record tools and stores: packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/{finalizeAttempt,recordCheckRun,recordCheckObservation,recordCheckDispatch,recordCommit,reattachAttempt,getCommitScope}.ts and packages/moe-daemon/src/state/{attemptStore,candidateStore,checkRunStore,checkObservationStore,receiptStore,deliveryProjection}.ts. Look for a member that skips a fence (attemptId/generation), a holder or role check, a status guard, a size cap, an idempotency rule or a coded refusal that its siblings apply. Note that recordCheckDispatch.ts and requestReplan.ts have no test file of their own.
2. The proposal and rail family: proposeRail.ts, StateManager's approveProposal/rejectProposal with the /ws APPROVE_PROPOSAL/REJECT_PROPOSAL handlers, src/state/railChange.ts and src/util/rails.ts. Look for a write path that stores plan or rail text without the check submit_plan applies (forbiddenPatterns, requiredPatterns, the EPIC rail's single-line and 10000-char cap), or a proposal transition that one entry point guards and another skips.
3. The step-lifecycle tools: start_step, complete_step, complete_task, request_replan, report_blocked, qa_approve and qa_reject. Look for a guard, fence, holder check or validation that one member applies and a sibling skips.

Skip:
- Every file an open row holds. At filing time that is scripts/moe-agent.{sh,ps1}, scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.{sh,ps1}, scripts/tests/postflight-fake-proxy.js, scripts/tests/parity-check.{sh,ps1}, scripts/moe-account-lease.mjs and its test, createTeam.ts and its test (67709965), and the files the four PLANNING rows are about to plan: acquireResource.ts, waitForResource.ts and resourceStore.ts (9f34bac5), setTaskStatus.ts (629ddc99), joinTeam.ts, teamStore.ts and joinTeam.deadMembers.test.ts (3962d9a0), releaseTask.ts, releaseResource.ts and claimGuards.ts (0adea941).
- Run `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/governor/lanes.js -v` when you start, because the list moves.

Already known, so don't re-file:
- Everything filed today (rows created on 2026-11-03), especially: the actor family (d981e0b0, 2e3012b9, e977c32b, c05bf92d, 3e1d0c2e, c927e484, 47c42043), complete_step's modifiedFiles cap (e3d41183), the chat family (b2f95099, 314405bb, 66108835, 3064fd45, 4877ef36), Docker (90ed6cb5), the role docs (1528e899), and hunt #9's rows plus 0adea941 (release_task/release_resource force).
- The git-land lease waiter that isn't woken when the lease frees: fixed by ceb494d9, not yet live (the daemon swap is pending with the human).
- TURBO auto-approve's "WORKING by unknown" line; the JetBrains board fingerprint omitting needsHumanReview; isEpicFinal's max-order fallback (msg-bbf4f109); a7d02ec3.
- Held items: hunt #7 (b), the wrapper's UNKNOWN-status message; hunt #8, the using-git-worktrees skill text and chat_send's whitespace-only content; hunt #9 (b), EpicDetailDialog's ARCHIVED through /ws UPDATE_EPIC.
- This checkout's local .serena/project.yml ignoring docs/.

EVIDENCE BAR. Same as hunts #2-#9. Work only from real evidence:
- A repro on HEAD 677d051a or later: the command and its observed output, run in a git archive or clone snapshot outside the shared checkout. Global rail: never build or test in place.
- A failure line from today's logs: the file and the timestamp.
- For a family or gate gap: the sibling file:line that applies the check, the member file:line that skips it, and a test or call that shows the difference.
No speculative or style-only findings.

OUTPUT AND HOW TO FINISH. This row produces no code and no plan, so do not call moe.submit_plan.
1. File each finding with moe.create_task in the epic that owns the code. Use status PLANNING, and add no dependsOn unless a real logic edge exists (in worktree mode a shared file gets a placement note, not an edge). Each row gets a problem statement, the evidence, a fix direction and 2-3 checkable DoD items. Prefer rows QA can check with one vitest file.
2. Post the ids, or "nothing real", in #governors and mention the governor (governor-e6b40560).
3. Archive this row yourself with moe.archive_task.
definitionOfDone: 2-4 new bug rows are filed in the epics that own the code, or "nothing real" is posted. Either way the outcome is posted in #governors.
Every filed row cites its evidence: a repro on HEAD 677d051a or later run outside the shared checkout, a failure line from today's logs, or a sibling/member (or doc/code) file:line pair.
No filed row targets a file an open row holds (per lanes.js at hunt time). The holder archives this row once the ids are posted.
